result.summary: Found 2 issues: a major broken restaurant image placeholder and a minor layout inconsistency in the promo banner.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows a broken-image placeholder icon instead of a restaurant photo, leaving a large empty gray area.
issues.suggestion: Load a valid restaurant image or provide a designed fallback (logo, cuisine illustration) so the card is not empty.

issues.description: The 'Order now' button in the green promo banner sits slightly off-center, closer to the left than the right within the pill.
issues.suggestion: Center the button label and adjust padding so it is visually balanced.
